description: Illustrative ANCFZ catalog fixture. Review and publish via Node before production use; not auto-loaded.

intents.name: Start a Company
intents.description: Help a new business owner choose a company structure, business activity, visa allocation and workspace, and optionally prepare a verified enquiry or quotation.
examplePhrases: I want to start a company

requirements.label: What will the company do?
requirements.hint: Ask only if not already supplied.

requirements.label: How many shareholders?
requirements.hint: Useful for FZE vs FZC structure.

requirements.label: How many visas will be needed?
requirements.hint: Ask after customer needs a visa-inclusive package comparison or quote.

requirements.label: What workspace do you prefer?
requirements.hint: Flexi-desk/shared office/private office; confirm actual package inclusions.

requirements.label: Which email should receive the enquiry?
requirements.hint: Only collect as part of a specifically consented lead; OTP identity handled outside model.

intents.name: Visa Services
intents.description: Explain residence visa services and help the customer request a case-specific enquiry.
examplePhrases: what visa services do you offer

intents.name: License Renewal
intents.description: Explain the licence-renewal process and help raise a renewal request.

intents.name: Corporate Banking Assistance
intents.description: Explain partner-bank assistance. Approval is solely at the bank's discretion.
examplePhrases: help me open a bank account

note: No real offering prices or workflow URLs are included; they must be separately authorized and verified in Node.
